item.label: Text
item.description: Input your desired button text.

item.label: Sub Text
item.description: Input your desired button sub text.

item.label: Icon
item.description: Choose an icon to display with your Advanced Button.

item.label: Image
item.description: Upload your desired image, or type in the URL to the image you would like to display.

item.label: Button Link URL
item.description: Input the destination URL for your button.

item.label: Button Link Download URL
item.description: Input the destination URL for your button to download.

item.label: Button Link Email
item.description: Input the destination URL for your button.

item.label: Button Link Contact No.
item.description: Input the destination Contact No. for your button action.

item.label: Button Link Target
item.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window

item.label: Icon Color
item.description: Here you can define a custom color for your icon.

item.label: Icon Size
item.description: Here you can choose Icon width.

item.label: Background Color
item.description: Here you can define a custom background color for your icon.

item.label: Button Alignment
item.description: Align your button to the left, right or center of the module.

item.label: Button Content Alignment
item.description: Align your content to the left, right or center of the Button.

item.label: Wrapper Width
item.description: Here you can choose Media Wrapper width.

item.label: Wrapper Height
item.description: Here you can choose Media Wrapper height.

item.label: Tooltip
item.description: Tooltip On/ Off.

item.label: Tooltip Content
item.description: Note: Html tags, shortcode are supported and shortcode will be view only frontend

item.label: Hover Over Tooltip
item.description: Tooltip allowing you to hover over and click inside it.

item.label: Tooltip Hover Area
item.description: Determines the size of the invisible border around the tooltip that will prevent it from hiding if the cursor left it.

item.label: Tooltip Content Delay [ms]
item.description: Determines the time in ms to show the Tooltip content when triggger.

item.label: Tooltip Content Hide Delay
item.description: Determines the time in ms to debounce the Tooltip content hide handler when the cursor leaves.

item.label: Max Width
item.description: Specifies the maximum width of the tooltip. Useful to prevent it from being too horizontally wide to read.

item.label: Tooltip Distance
item.description: Displaces the tippy from its reference element in pixels (skidding and distance).

item.label: Tooltip Horizontal Position
item.description: Tooltip horizontal distance length from element to tooltip.

item.label: Tooltip Vertical Position
item.description: Tooltip vertical distance length from spot to tooltip
